subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public TTS delivery policy that lets Telegram users choose separate text-plus-voice delivery, and should that policy live under global messages.tts or Telegram/channel-specific config?
rationale: The request is valid source-level UX friction, but it adds public config and overlaps with captioned-final, voice-only, and other-channel TTS text-preservation proposals.

options.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for bundled/captioned/separate behavior before implementation.

options.title: Keep captioned delivery
options.body: Reject the separate-delivery selector and document tagged/manual workarounds plus caption-overflow behavior instead.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final settles
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 direction before deciding the permanent config shape.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Define a backward-compatible delivery mode with docs and tests for bundled/captioned/separate behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing signal across TTS config, speech-core history, and Telegram delivery policy.
